system.description:
Required Weapon: Dual Axes A Vestenmennavenjar style of relentless aggression. Though ancient in practice, it has only recently been formalized. It emphasizes overwhelming pressure and violence.

  • Winter's Fury. Once per Rest, spend any number of Hope to strike a target of your choice within Melee range. Roll a number of d6s equal to the Hope spent and deal that much damage to the target.
  • Promise of Death. Make a Brawn Roll against an enemy within Close range. On a success, the next time they mark HP, one enemy within Very Close range of them must mark the same amount in Stress.
  • Raider's Vitality. Once per Rest, when you would drop to 0 HP, you may mark all your Stress. If you do, you remain at 1 HP and your next roll gains Advantage.
